Q13. How much, if at all, do you think each of the following would help make pursuing a college degree a better investment for Americans?
Q13_1. Lower the price of tuition and fees
Q13_2. Provide comprehensive career counseling in high school to help students understand the best pathway to their career goals
Q13_3. Provide comprehensive career counseling to students throughout their time in college
Q13_4. Create internships and training programs that allow students to get job experience while earning a degree
Q13_5. Create partnerships between colleges and employers that establish a direct job placement pipeline for graduates
Q13_6. Provide students with a broad base of knowledge and transferable skills (e.g., critical thinking, communication, problem-solving, how to use artificial intelligence in the workforce)
Q13_7. Ensure additional financial support is available to meet students’ basic needs (housing, food, transportation, or childcare)
Q13_8. Require colleges to take on some financial risk, such as paying a share of the loan balance if alumni default
Q13_9. Provide financial bonuses to colleges and universities that do an exceptional job of serving low-income students
Q13_10. Require colleges to publicly report in an easily accessible format, the median earnings and typical debt for graduates by major
Q13_11. Reduce the total number of credits required for a degree to make it easier for students to graduate quicker
